description: The public links a report has had, newest first, ended ones included: each one's id, whether it is open, held on an older version or ended, the version it shows, when it ends, who made it and whether an assistant did. A password-protected link carries passwordProtected: true. The address (https://reports.codegene.ai/...) is shown only to the person who made the link and to the workspace's owners and admins.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
